review_scope: Actual uninstrumented roweight/helper fragment. Root independently reviews all actual conv2d/outlined dispatch functions before merging. No production object retained; no old-C40/C47 machine-code identity or performance claim.

helpers.stack_frame_description: Fixed624-byte frame from SUB sp,sp,#624 at5708; no scalable ADDVL/RDVL allocation. Only X/W register saves and scalar/pointer locals appear. Unlike C47, this actual helper uses no z8..z15 and has no D8..D15 ABI save/restore instructions. Saved X19..X28 and frame/link registers are integer ABI state, not vector spills. Arguments at old-SP are reused for the second rowquad tail call after restoring the frame.
helpers.spill_count_scope: Static Z/Q/predicate data-spill instruction sites over the complete5705..6799 helper, including setup, all transitions, skipped-loop initialization, stores and fallback. These are not dynamic memory-operation totals.
helpers.spill_notes: No Z/Q/predicate LDR/STR, no vector LD/ST through a stack-derived address and no D-register saves are present in the complete helper. x29=sp+16 is the only constructed SP alias and never feeds vector memory. Fixed slots112..216 and224..616 contain scalar dimensions, offsets or external input/kernel/output pointers; subsequent LD1W/LD1RW/ST1W through loaded external pointers are not stack spills. All16 accumulators remain in registers throughout the fifteen stages, while only two input windows and reused coefficient/product temporaries are needed. Scalar X26/X27 and X24 bookkeeping saves atsp+200/+208/+216 around shared are integer pointer preservation, not Z26/Z27 accumulator spills.
helpers.transition_spill_review: Read every line5705..6799 including all out-of-line branches. Leading phases initialize the next pair of accumulators in registers. input_6 .L4076160..6207 uses x0 as a moving kernel-column pointer and increments it by4 bytes while incrementing ik by1; it still performs exactly one kernel column, with14 FMUL/14 FADD. .L3946208 initializes h, saves scalar pointer state and sets t=7. Shared setup x4/x5/x6/x7/x8/x9/x10/x11 represents kernel rows7/6/5/4/3/2/1/0; x3 is input row t plus1VL, and x12=x3-oneVL_bytes is its first window. .L4086285 advances t, all eight kernel pointers by4*kw and x3 by4*stride, then repeats until t==kh. Shared exits restore only scalar pointer state. The seven trailing phases advance the still-active outputs and retain completed outputs in registers until16 ST1W stores in .L4116551. .L4276658 initializes the14 leading accumulators when kw<=0 then joins .L394, avoiding uninitialized values without vector stack materialization. No live output accumulator crosses either fallback call.
helpers.tail_and_fallback_review: CMP kh,7 / BLE .L391 precedes the eight-row pointer setup. .L3916747..6781 calls rowquad on outputs0..3, then tail-branches rowquad at base+4*stride on outputs4..7. The second call writes dst7 and width into old-SP argument slots before restoring624 bytes, matching rowquad calling convention; these are scalar call arguments, not vector spills. Full tiles require ow-i >= CNTH, numerically2*svcntw float outputs; INCH advances i by precisely2*lanes, and x24 advances pointers by4*(2*lanes) bytes. Width-small .L4596782 sets i=0 and joins .L393. Positive horizontal remainder goes through .L4606687, two rowquad calls at column i and original global stride/dst-row pointers, covering outputs0..3 and4..7; no new full-vector load is issued for the partial tile by roweight. All fifteen phases increment ik by1 and check signed CMP/BGT kw, so kw=1 and odd/even kw need no separate unrolled-column remainder. Last input vector begins i+lanes+ik and ends i+2*lanes+ik-1 <= ow+kw-2. Last input row kh+6 is exactly required by output7. Per-output kernel rows0..kh-1 and columns0..kw-1 remain ordered, with separate FMUL/FADD.
helpers.arithmetic_and_load_review: Shared .L4096230..6284 is54 actual instructions per single kernel column:16 ordinary FMUL,16 FADD,2 input LD1W,8 LD1RW coefficient broadcasts,1 LSL,9 ADD,1 CMP and1 BGT. No indexed FMUL, LD1RQW, DUP, EXT, MOVPRFX, vector MOV or spill occurs there. z1/z0 hold the two input windows; coefficient z2 is repeatedly broadcast/reused, with z27/z28 coefficient/product temporaries for the last two output rows. Thus actual scheduling mostly processes the two horizontal windows by output row; it does not hold eight coefficient vectors simultaneously. Fifteen-stage ordinary FMUL/FADD counts are2/4/6/8/10/12/14/16/14/12/10/8/6/4/2, with two input loads each and1..8..1 coefficient broadcasts. input_6 is47 instructions versus trailing_0 at48 because its kernel pointer increments directly rather than using an LSL; both normalize to one column. Static instruction/stack observations alone do not establish cycle count or a speed advantage.
